stage_name_zh: 阶段 1：词汇激活、熟词生义破冰与句子主干剖析（Day 1–25）
learning_objectives_zh: 通过 8 个核心词群（涵盖今日 27 个目标词条）掌握熟悉词汇的学术熟词生义（Polysemy）、一词多义边界、可数/及物性变化与自然搭配。
掌握句子成分精细分析（主、谓、宾、表、定、状、同位语）与核心语法：【G020】语态的语篇决策：基于研究对象、旧信息前置与施事责任的主动/被动选择；【G032】消除“头重脚轻（Top-Heavy Subject）”与遵循尾重原则（End-Weight Principle）。
掌握学术表达模式：【EP019】机器学习与时间序列：问题定义、滞后项与符号约定，彻底消除头重脚轻、口语化、过度表达与空洞 AI 套话。
完成 36 道高密度、单点聚焦的实战练习，确保今日每个词条均获得至少 3 次训练（含至少 2 次主动输出）。

grammar_instruction.name: 语态的语篇决策：基于研究对象、旧信息前置与施事责任的主动/被动选择
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 破除“被动语态一定比主动语态更学术”的迷思。语态选择服务于：(1) 维持句间话题链连贯（把上句提到的受事对象作为本句被动主语，满足 Given-before-New），(2) 明确谁对设计决策或核验承担责任。
rules: 当描述标准化数据清洗、传感器部署或客观流程，且受事对象是段落主题时，选用被动语态（The records are arranged in chronological order before the time-series analysis）。
当阐述本文核心创新设计、范围限定决策或强调多名标注者独立操作时，选用主动语态（We confine the analysis to...; Two analysts analysed the data independently; The algorithm exploits the sparsity of the matrix）。
examples: Passive for topic continuity: The predictions are compared with ground-truth labels that were checked by two annotators.
Active for clear methodological agency: We reformulate the constrained problem as an equivalent optimization problem.
common_errors: 通篇机械使用被动语态导致语句冗长、施事责任模糊（如分不清是前人文献做的还是本文做的）。

grammar_instruction.name: 消除“头重脚轻（Top-Heavy Subject）”与遵循尾重原则（End-Weight Principle）
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 中国学习者与劣质机翻最常见的句法缺陷是“头重脚轻（Top-Heavy Sentence）”——主语长达十几个词，谓语却只是一个软弱的 is / occurs / exists。地道英语严格遵循“尾重原则（End-Weight）”：主语简短（旧信息），把复杂的从句、长列表或重信息放在谓语之后（句末焦点位置）。
rules: 诊断头重脚轻：当主语超过 8–10 个词且包含从句或多层 of 短语，而谓语仅为 be/have/exist 时，必须重构句子。

重构方法 1（换用核心实体作主语+强动词）：把长主语中的行动者、模型或实验设为短主语，将原抽象名词还原为谓语动词（如把 *The investigation of how irregular sampling intervals affect autocorrelation estimation is important 改为 *We investigate how irregular sampling intervals affect autocorrelation estimation* 或 *Irregular sampling intervals can distort autocorrelation estimates*）。
重构方法 2（右移重成分或使用先行 it / 存在结构）：当需要评价某个复杂命题时，用 It is critical that... 或將状语条件移至句首/句末。
examples:
头重脚轻病句：*Whether the learned policy can generalize from simulation to a physical robot with actuator delays and sensor noise is uncertain.*
地道改写：*It remains uncertain whether the learned policy can generalize from simulation to a physical robot with actuator delays and sensor noise.* 或 *Actuator delays and sensor noise make sim-to-real policy transfer uncertain.*

头重脚轻病句：*A discrepancy between the recorded timestamps and the sensor logs in the second rollout was found.*
地道改写：*The audit revealed a discrepancy between the recorded timestamps and the sensor logs in the second rollout.*
common_errors: 主语塞满三四个 of 嵌套短语，导致读者读到句尾才看到一个单薄的 is。
用 Whether / That 名词性从句作长主语而谓语只有一个形容词。

grammar_instruction.name: 可数名词、不可数名词及多义词在不同义项下的可数性切换
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 不仅要区分绝对不可数名词（evidence, information, research, literature, equipment, apparatus, documentation, feedback, knowledge）与可数名词（study, finding, discrepancy, anomaly, covariate），更要掌握“同一单词在不同词义下的可数性切换”（Rule A.2）。
rules: 不可数学术名词不加 a/an 或复数 -s（严禁写 *an evidence, *researches, *equipments, *feedbacks）；表单项用 a piece/item of evidence, a research study, a piece of equipment。
一词多义下的可数性切换：discipline 表“纪律”不可数，表“学科”可数（two academic disciplines）；work 表“研究工作”不可数，workings 表“计算步骤”；experience 表“经验”不可数，表“经历”可数（experiences in childhood）；paper 表“纸”不可数，表“论文”可数。
量词精确匹配：修饰不可数用 a great deal of, a large amount of, much, less and less；修饰可数复数用 a large number of, a handful of, many, fewer and fewer。
examples: The transcription required a great deal of effort.
A large number of records still require checking.
The project draws on two academic disciplines.
All apparatus was checked before the experiment.
common_errors: 量词与可数性错配：*a great deal of participants / *an amount of respondents / *fewer time。
不可数名词误加复数：*many evidences / *new equipments / *useful feedbacks。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 机器学习与时间序列：问题定义、滞后项与符号约定
expression_pattern_instruction.template: Let [symbol] denote the observation at time t; we decompose the series into [components] and evaluate predictions over horizon H.
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 用于机器学习与时间序列论文的 Problem Formulation 部分，清晰界定输入历史窗口、滞后项（lagged observations）与预测步长。
examples: Here, N denotes the number of observations, and a lag of one step links the current state to the preceding observation.
Time-series decomposition separates a series into components such as trend, seasonality and remainder.
common_errors: 未说明采样间隔（sampling interval）就直接声称某个 lag 代表固定物理时长。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 客观归属文献观点或档案记录来源
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 准确区分外部文献说法与本文实证判断。
examples: According to the authors, the evaluation uses synthetic sentences.
According to the records, the event began before sunset.
common_errors: *According to me（第一人称严禁使用）。

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：不能把系统整体当作 component 的同义词。
学术语境与搭配约束：本单元指“理解”，较正式；该词另有“包含”义，应按上下文区分，可用 include 明确表达包含。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: Readers need sufficient context to comprehend the argument.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00499 adj.] 全面的（例：The review requires comprehensive data on all study sites.）；[V00500 adj.] 全面的；包含所需各部分的（例：A comprehensive review should explain its search criteria.）；[V00501 adj.] 全面的；覆盖广的（例：Comprehensive records include the study’s exclusions.） | 本条用法约束：强调覆盖完整。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The review requires comprehensive data on all study sites.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00499 adj.] 全面的（例：The review requires comprehensive data on all study sites.）；[V00500 adj.] 全面的；包含所需各部分的（例：A comprehensive review should explain its search criteria.）；[V00501 adj.] 全面的；覆盖广的（例：Comprehensive records include the study’s exclusions.） | 本条用法约束：全面是范围评价，不能仅凭篇幅长作判断。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: A comprehensive review should explain its search criteria.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00499 adj.] 全面的（例：The review requires comprehensive data on all study sites.）；[V00500 adj.] 全面的；包含所需各部分的（例：A comprehensive review should explain its search criteria.）；[V00501 adj.] 全面的；覆盖广的（例：Comprehensive records include the study’s exclusions.） | 本条用法约束：说明具体覆盖范围，避免无依据强评价。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: Comprehensive records include the study’s exclusions.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：主动comprise直接接组成部分；可用consist of改写。
词义与句法边界：与 optional 相对；不自行推定任何语言课一定必修。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The handbook states whether the workshop is compulsory.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：calculate 近义词，常用于计算过程。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The code computes a statistic for each district.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：concept of；不要将日常含义与技术定义混用。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The concept of independence has a precise statistical meaning.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：结论须由前文证据支持。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The authors conclude that further external validation is needed.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：与 abstract 对应；material concrete 另指混凝土。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The report provides a concrete example of unequal access.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00520 v.] 开展（例：The students conducted a survey of travel habits.）；[V00521 v.] 开展，实施（例：The team conducted interviews in three districts.）；[V00522 v.] 开展；实施（例：The team will conduct a survey of access to recycling services.） | 本条用法约束：作动词直接接 research、a study、a survey 或 an experiment；conducted 为过去式。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The students conducted a survey of travel habits.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00520 v.] 开展（例：The students conducted a survey of travel habits.）；[V00521 v.] 开展，实施（例：The team conducted interviews in three districts.）；[V00522 v.] 开展；实施（例：The team will conduct a survey of access to recycling services.） | 本条用法约束：conduct 指实施；examine 可指审查已有访谈。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The team conducted interviews in three districts.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00520 v.] 开展（例：The students conducted a survey of travel habits.）；[V00521 v.] 开展，实施（例：The team conducted interviews in three districts.）；[V00522 v.] 开展；实施（例：The team will conduct a survey of access to recycling services.） | 本条用法约束：conduct a survey 与 carry out a survey；不是 conduct an experience。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The team will conduct a survey of access to recycling services.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 搭配介词 to（confine A to B），用于清晰划定方法或结论的适用边界。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: We confine the analysis to observations collected before the policy change.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00528 v.] 确认；支持已有判断（例：The replication did not confirm the original finding.）；[V00529 v.] 证实；确认（例：The follow-up check confirmed the transcription error.） | 本条用法约束：在证据语境中须区分支持和逻辑证明；确认预订是普通义。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The replication did not confirm the original finding.
